description: robots.txt (RFC 9309) rule reading with llms.txt and AI-use signals — Reads a supplied robots.txt the RFC 9309 way for an agent deciding whether to fetch up to 25 paths as one product-token user agent: group selection (merged groups, "*" fallback), longest-match with the Allow-wins-tie rule, "*" and "$" patterns, percent-encoding normalization, fetch-status handling (4xx = no rules, 5xx = disallow all), the rule and line that decided each path. It also lints a suppl

fetchStatus.description: HTTP status the robots.txt fetch ended with (after at most 5 redirects). Omit when robotsTxt is supplied and was a 2xx.

headers.description: Response headers of the page: X-Robots-Tag, tdm-reservation, tdm-policy.

metaTags.description: HTML meta elements: robots, googlebot, tdm-reservation, tdm-policy.

paths.description: Path plus optional query beginning with /, or a full http(s) URL (path and query are used).

purpose.description: ai-training also treats noai, noimageai and tdm-reservation: 1 as restrictions. Default crawl.

robotsTxt.description: robots.txt body, at most 512,000 UTF-8 bytes (500 KiB).

userAgent.description: Product token only (letters, underscore, hyphen), e.g. "Googlebot"; no version.

name: robots-check
